Our Story

Founded in 2003 in Algiers, SARI Système was born from the vision of providing Algerian healthcare professionals with cutting-edge, accessible and reliable medical equipment.

Our Values

🎯 Excellence

We aim for excellence in every customer interaction.

🤝 Proximity

A relationship of trust with our customers and partners.

💡 Innovation

Always at the forefront of medical technologies.

🛡️ Reliability

Equipment you can count on.

Our Key Figures

After 20 years of activity, we are proud of our achievements:

  • 500+ equipped facilities
  • 9 categories of medical solutions
  • 24/7 technical support available
  • 48 provinces covered
